name: io.github.cyberfilo/musicmind-mcp
description: MCP server giving Claude deep, intelligent access to Apple Music — taste profiling, adaptive recommendations, audio analysis, and smart playlist generation. Caches your library/listening history locally and builds a multi-dimensional taste profile (genres, artists, audio traits) to score new music against your actual preferences instead of popularity.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Apple Music API developer token (JWT signed with your team's MusicKit private key). See README for token generation.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Apple Music user token obtained via MusicKit JS / Swift on a logged-in device. Scopes the server to a single user's library and listening history.

environmentVariables.name: MUSICMIND_CACHE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Filesystem path for the local SQLite cache. Defaults to $HOME/.musicmind/cache.db.
